title: Story premise EDU088: The Timer Erases an Unfinished Form
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (accessibility/inclusion). Hook: Why did the form disappear before the answer was ready? Takeaway/theme: Time limits should be considered explicitly in accessible interaction design.
description: A user wants to finish a form at their own pace, but an unexpected timeout clears entered information. A reviewed design exposes timing, offers appropriate continuation, and preserves progress where permitted.
